quests.title: Remnants of Civilization
quests.description: TC167 crashed near the airport. Reach the maintenance hangar and find a way to move her.
hints: The maintenance hangar may contain useful equipment.
Ground support vehicles were likely stored near aircraft maintenance facilities.

journal.initial: The airport is closer than I thought. Several buildings are still standing. If this was a maintenance facility, there may be equipment I can use. I need to find a way to move TC167. Walking back and forth isn't going to accomplish much.
journal.complete: I found an old utility vehicle in one of the service buildings. Somehow, it still works. At least now I have a way to move equipment around the airbase. Next, I need something capable of carrying TC167.
journal.hangar: The hangar is still standing. There's enough room here to work on TC167, assuming I can find a way to get her inside. There must have been ground support equipment somewhere around this airbase.
journal.discover: A utility vehicle. I wasn't expecting to find one intact. Now the question is whether it still works.
journal.inspect: It appears to be in better condition than most of the equipment I've seen. I might actually be able to get this thing moving.

quests.title: The Means of Recovery
quests.description: Find equipment capable of recovering TC167.
